paraphrase: Lecture on Ethics: religious terms seem to be used as similes or allegorically (God who sees everything, to whom we kneel and pray, as a human being of great power), but a simile must be the simile of something, and the facts these experiences would describe cannot be stated without it; so the expressions are nonsense, their nonsensicality being their very essence.
